purpose: Document first-party registry/map discovery, public-service routes, bounded anonymous request outcomes, and safety limits.
assessment: Junagadh local custody is evidenced by official DILR and City Survey Office pages. Gujarat Revenue Department lists AnyRoR rural record viewing and e-Milkat property-card viewing, but no safe anonymous native-ID-plus-complete-geometry response was verified.
registryAssessment: The Junagadh DILR and City Survey Office are city/district custodians evidenced by the official district administration. The Gujarat Revenue Department and national CLR report are broader state/national service or reporting sources, not substitutes for proving citywide open geometry.
